books.title: Leo’s Star
pages: Leo the lion found a shiny star in the grass.
He showed it to his friends: a bird, a monkey, and a turtle.
“Let’s share it!” said Leo. They made a night lamp together.
Moral: Sharing makes light brighter.

books.title: Rain Day
pages: Maya looked out — grey clouds!
She wore her yellow raincoat and red boots.
Splash! Puddle jump! Plop — she laughed.
After rain, a rainbow! 🌈

books.title: Counting Apples
pages: 1 apple, 2 apples, 3 apples on the tree.
Count with me: 4, 5, 6 — pick the red ones.
We have 6 apples. Let’s share 3 each.
Can you count 6 fingers?

books.title: Feelings Fair
pages: Sam felt sad. His tower fell.
A friend hugged him: “It’s okay to feel sad.”
They built again together — now Sam feels proud.
Feelings come and go, like clouds.

books.title: Shape Town
pages: Circle rolls, square stacks, triangle points.
Find shapes in town: window (square), wheel (circle).
Draw your town with 3 shapes.
What shape is the roof? 🔺

books.title: Ocean Friends
pages: Dolphin clicks, whale sings — can you hear?
Coral hides clownfish — peekaboo!
Octopus waves 8 arms — hello!
Keep the ocean clean: no plastic. ♻️

books.title: Helper Day
pages: Doctor checks ears, firefighter lifts ladder, teacher reads.
Helpers wear uniforms and smiles.
Who helps you? Draw them.
Thank a helper today!

books.title: Space Hop
pages: Rocket 5-4-3-2-1 — blast off!
Moon is dusty, Mars is red.
Astronaut floats: “Hello Earth!”
Stars twinkle — count 10!

books.title: Garden Helpers
pages: Mia waters seeds. Sun warms soil.
Sprout peeks: hello! 🌱
Bees buzz, ladybugs spot — garden friends.
We pick tomatoes — red, ripe, yummy!

books.title: My Family
pages: This is my family: Mama, Baba, and me.
We eat together, read together, laugh together.
Family hug! Biggest hug ever.
Who is in your family? Draw them.

books.title: Numbers in the Wild
pages: 2 giraffes stretch necks.
5 zebras trot — stripes flash!
10 birds fly V — count them.
Nature loves numbers.

books.title: The Kind Dragon
pages: Dara the dragon breathed warm, not hot.
She warmed cold bunnies in winter.
Friends said: “Kind is strong.”
Be kind like Dara — share warmth.

books.title: The Sleepy Bear
pages: Benny Bear yawned — winter is coming.
He gathered leaves for a cozy bed.
Friends tucked him in: “Sleep well, Benny!”
In spring, he woke — hello, sun! 🌞

books.title: Colors Everywhere
pages: Look! Red apple, blue sky, yellow sun.
Green leaf, purple flower, orange cat.
What color is your shirt today?
Let’s paint a rainbow together! 🌈

books.title: My Five Senses
pages: I see with my eyes — bright stars!
I hear with my ears — birds chirp.
I smell flowers, taste mango, touch soft fur.
Five senses help me explore the world!

books.title: Kind Words
pages: Mina said, “Please” — door opened.
She said, “Thank you” — smiles grew.
Kind words are like warm sun.
Try today: say please, thank you, sorry.
